recommend.description: the user wants a recommendation or suggestion

compare.description: the user wants alternatives or options compared

decide.description: the user is making or requesting help with a decision

plan.description: the user wants a plan, itinerary, workflow, or structured approach

learn.description: the user wants information or an explanation

review.description: the user wants something examined, checked, verified, or evaluated

brainstorm.description: the user wants ideas or possibilities

troubleshoot.description: the user is diagnosing or fixing a problem

other.description: clear intent exists but none of the above is appropriate
